title: Deep link zoom to fit crashes the editor when page bounds are not finite
reason: The sole comment links the upstream PR; the issue says the crash occurs in the fallback fit path for non-finite page bounds, distinct from malformed URL parsing.
assessment: Varve's deep-link contract does not encode tldraw's page-fit fallback, and its shared fitBoundsCameraWithRotation normalizes invalid rectangles and finite camera inputs before calculating the fit. No crash analogue was found in the navigation path.

title: Draw and highlight shape interpolation throws when one side has no points
reason: Reports the empty-array edge case in shared draw/highlight segment interpolation after empty shapes became valid. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's timeline path interpolation calls ensureVertexMatch before interpolatePath; ensureVertexMatch explicitly pads an empty side with a finite origin point. The zero-point input therefore does not trigger the cited undefined-last-vertex failure.
